text: The truncation HIT ‖A‖ₙ satisfies the elimination rule: to define f: ‖A‖ₙ→B (with B an n-type), it suffices to give:
choices: f on the generators of ‖A‖ₙ and check coherences
A function A→B (since B is n-truncated, it extends uniquely)
A proof that B is contractible
explanation: n-Truncation universal property: maps ‖A‖ₙ→B for n-truncated B correspond to maps A→B.
